verdict.rationale: Amplitude's first-party Feature Experiment docs describe the core story. You can release behind a flag and ramp it to a chosen audience with a kill switch, define audiences by user properties, cohorts, or segments, and evaluate flags through Experiment SDKs (including local evaluation) across web, mobile, and backend. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of percentage-based rollout (only implied by 'ramp'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of flag targeting.
